law: rank_2 W(3,q) = (q^2+1)(q+2)/2   (q odd PRIME; see Pass 262)
reading: W(3,13) was built (2380 points, 2380 isotropic lines) and its F2 incidence rank computed directly, giving a fresh independent anchor for the odd-q law. Together with q = 3,5,7,11 the law is now attested at five odd primes. NOTE: every one of these anchors is a PRIME; whether the same polynomial holds at odd prime POWERS is a separate question, settled in Pass 262.
